description: This file defines a small library for managing a stack of signal handlers in a C program. It provides functions to push and pop signal handlers for specific signals, as well as for common signals such as SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, and SIGPIPE. It includes a typedef for signal handler functions compatible with signal() or sigaction(), and functions to manage the stack of handlers, enabling cleanup and restoration of previous handlers.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a custom signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the topmost signal handler for a specific signal from the stack.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for common signals like SIGINT, SIGHUP, SIGTERM, SIGQUIT, and SIGPIPE.

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Removes handlers for the common signals.
